result:
Nothing at Likelihood 3 or higher is unsettled. `bun tools/check-register.ts` exited 0 over 436 items, and all four of its counts were 0.

The checker reads only the last `Status:` in an entry. I read all of them myself: 38 entries at Likelihood 3 or higher carry more than one. The last Status is the current one, and in each of the 38 it is settled.

**Settled by a later probe or test (earlier line was `open` or `partial`)**

| Entry | Current | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|
| RISK-401 | mitigated | Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block. |
| RISK-411 | mitigated | The session-start fill removes the retired text. |
| RISK-374 | mitigated | The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused. |
| RISK-391, RISK-393 | mitigated | The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the old one. An earlier acceptance was withdrawn because it was the user's to give. |
| RISK-170, 199, 223 | mitigated | The shipped agent files cover it. |
| RISK-222 | mitigated | `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus. |
| RISK-186 | mitigated | The Bash wrapper made git commands in an isolated worktree non-simple, and they were refused. Git commands are now left unwrapped. Model-written expansions remain, at Likelihood 5 and Impact 2. |
| RISK-053 | mitigated | The sandbox and Read deny rules refuse every probed shell channel. A wall-guard gap (#42) was closed. |
| RISK-067 | mitigated | The ask rules cover git, and Claude Code refuses dangerous `rm` itself. The disk-cleanup part has no control and rests on one report. Residual Likelihood is 2. |
| RISK-103 | mitigated | Middle-wildcard rule forms deny all seven force-push and stash forms probed. |
| RISK-424 | mitigated | The threshold test pins the literal 70000. |
| RISK-132 | mitigated | The handover keeps user refusals word for word. An option the agent ruled out alone is rechecked by the next session. |

| Entry | Reason recorded |
|---|---|
| RISK-410 | The cause is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190). It was closed, reopened, then closed again. |
| RISK-166 | Not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327. |
| RISK-169 | The removed `SubagentStop` guard leaves nothing to cure. Likelihood stays 4 as accepted engine behaviour. |
| RISK-055 | `pkill` and `killall` ask first. |
| RISK-059, 071 | The gate that caused it was dropped (OUT-035). |
| RISK-063 | Destructive git and the user settings file ask first. |
| RISK-064 | The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary. |
| RISK-463 | The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 runs. |

**Closed, reopened, then mitigated by an output-style line**

- **RISK-226, 227, 262, 264, 278, 352, 353, 362:** the vanilla "not reproduced" closing was withdrawn when the fault reproduced. They are now mitigated because the output-style paragraph beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
- **RISK-497:** the last Status is mitigated: line 3 beats vanilla on two fixtures, 6/6 against 0/6 and 4/6 against 0/6, and holds the control at 6/6.
- **RISK-416:** mitigated by the `perl -pi` line. The runs used `perl` 3 of 3 times, and the probe ran with 0 denials.
- **RISK-171, 185, 451:** mitigated by an output-style or agent-file paragraph that beats vanilla on the probe fixtures. For 185 and 451, an earlier agent-written acceptance was reopened under issue #57.

**Moved Out**

- **RISK-462:** moved Out as OUT-2777.

**Caveat on RISK-462.** The checker only tests a Moved Out reason for entries with no Status line, and RISK-462 has one. The reason in OUT-2777 is that vanilla already corrects wrong tool calls (0 wrong calls in 4 of 4 runs). That is not "a part plugins/ does not ship", so the checker would reject it if the entry had no Status line. Whether that move is acceptable is your call. I have not changed the checker or the entry.

I did not check the Verified lines themselves, or whether each Status has the probe it cites. The checker confirms only that a Verified line exists.
